items.title: Rain launches instant-issue physical cards
items.why: Treat Rain's 3.6x spend claim as vendor data, not an independent benchmark, before using it in issuance planning.
items.summary_ai: Rain now offers instant-issue physical cards, citing much higher spend per physical cardholder than per virtual card holder.
